svg.title: A change of flow reverses accumulation
svg.desc: Inflow stays at100 milliliters per minute. Outflow is80 for the first three minutes and120 for the next three. Volume rises linearly from500 to560 milliliters, then falls to500. The volume is continuous at the flow change.
